frame_timestamp_convention: frames/SSS.sss.jpg is the requested elapsed-second position; decoder selects the first frame at or after it. Event boundaries are approximate unless bracketed by cited observations.

opponent_ai_status: not separately established; no inference from Auto
outcome: player defeat, 1-3, turn 10; literal Defeat and results screen recorded
